clauses: Clicking `tango` sets the clipboard to its IPv4, and its `copied` feedback reads true; clicking the `bravo` delegate sets it to `100.64.0.2`
The row has one right-button-only area

A right-click on `tango` opens `ts-copy-menu` with `displayName` `tango`; `ts-copy-ip4`, `ts-copy-ip6` and `ts-copy-dns` each read enabled, copy the IPv4, the IPv6 and `tango.example-tailnet.ts.net`, and close the menu
A right-click on `workstation`, whose `HostName` is `localhost`, heads the menu `workstation`
On `yankee`, without IPv6, `ts-copy-ip6` is visible, disabled, labelled in `Theme.textDisabled` and leaves the clipboard alone
